snippet.title: Mystic Pathways: Crystal Quest | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
#AfilGames #MysticPathwaysCrystalQuest

✨Mystic Pathways: Crystal Quest Launch Trailer ✨
🧚🏻‍♀️ Available for Nintendo Switch, Playstation, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One and Microsoft Store!

The fairies are back! Now with more crystals, more magic, and a lot more enchanted trouble! Mystic Pathways: Crystal Quest is the sparkling sequel that takes puzzles to a new level of strategic cuteness.

KEY FEATURES:
✨ Grid-based logic puzzles across 30 magical levels;
✨ Three enchanted zones: Forest, Swamp, and Cave;
✨ Piece rotation and path-building with increasing difficulty;
✨ Collect crystals, guide fairies, and get delightfully lost in the magic;

Get yours 👇🏻👇🏻👇🏻
🧚🏻‍♀️ Nintendo Switch:  https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/mystic-pathways-crystal-quest-switch/
🧚🏻‍♀️ Playstation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10015311
🧚🏻‍♀️ Xbox Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/mystic-pathways-crystal-quest/9N2RFJZRSD9H/0010
🧚🏻‍♀️ Xbox One: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/mystic-pathways-crystal-quest-xbox-one/9P4DSHDJ815B
